name: Derek Blake is the active primary contact for Globex
description: Derek Blake is the active primary contact for Globex

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM "user" u
JOIN contact c ON c.portal_user_id = u.user_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = c.account_id
WHERE u.user_id = 622
  AND u.email = 'derek.blake7@globex.com'
  AND a.account_id = 4
  AND a.name = 'Globex'
  AND c.contact_id = 3
  AND c.active = 1
  AND c.is_primary = 1;

description: Previous primary contact for Globex is no longer marked primary

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM contact
WHERE contact_id = 2
  AND account_id = 4
  AND active = 1
  AND is_primary = 0;

name: Case opened for HPE ProLiant DL380 Gen10 with Derek as the contact
description: Case opened for HPE ProLiant DL380 Gen10 with Derek as the contact

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customer_case
WHERE case_id = 1233
  AND number = 'CS-0001233'
  AND account_id = 4
  AND contact_id = 3
  AND product_id = 123
  AND channel = 'email'
  AND priority = 'moderate'
  AND state = 'new';

name: Relevant KB for HPE ProLiant DL380 Gen10 is linked
description: Relevant KB for HPE ProLiant DL380 Gen10 is linked

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM case_knowledge ck
JOIN knowledge k ON k.knowledge_id = ck.knowledge_id
WHERE ck.case_id = 1233
  AND ck.knowledge_id = 189
  AND ck.used_as = 'suggested'
  AND k.product_id = 123
  AND k.state = 'published';
